CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document.currency ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name_uz TEXT, name_ru TEXT, name_en TEXT, symbol VARCHAR(10), sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP, version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 );
INSERT INTO document.currency (code, name_uz, name_ru, name_en, symbol, sort_order, is_active) VALUES ('UZS', 'So''m', 'Сум', 'Som', 'so''m', 1, TRUE), ('USD', 'AQSh dollari', 'Доллар США', 'US Dollar', '$', 2, TRUE), ('RUB', 'Rossiya rubli', 'Российский рубль', 'Russian Ruble', '₽', 3, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
